about: Ground plan for the north-pool area (docs/SMOOTH_PATHS.md, drawn by src/ground-plan.ts, checked by scripts/check_ground_plan.py). World metres: x east, z south.
trust: The crazy-paving path is the photo-traced band from data/north_pool_gardens.json (IMG_2204-2206, 2208), now a smooth centreline. The lawn is bounded by that path, Calle Isabel and the dark hedge line the aerial shows on the south; the deck is cut out of it. Edges good to about a metre.

surfaces.name: North pool lawn
surfaces.note: IMG_2204 and IMG_2205 (upper-floor views over the courtyard) show lawn all round the pool deck, from the crazy-paving path on the north and west to the hedges on the south and the paved lane on the east. Its north and west sides are the path's pool-side edge, its east side Calle Isabel's lawn-side edge, its south side the dark hedge line traced from the aerial (scripts/trace_ground.py lawn; the aerial reads the shaded, worn north lawn as not green, so only the south edge is traced). The measured deck is cut out. Good to about a metre.

surfaces.name: North pool · crazy-paving lawn-edge path
surfaces.note: Photo-supported: irregular pale stone paving follows the curved retaining frontage at the northwest and the lower plinths across the north side, flush with the lawn (IMG_2204-2206, 2208). Estimated: 0.96 m width and exact plan curve (about +-2 m registration). Moved 2026-11-14 from data/north_pool_gardens.json as the centreline of its traced band. IMG_2204 shows the paving continuing down the west side along the curved white wall and along the south side behind the hedges; those continuations are not traced yet (task ground-plan-north-pool). 2026-11-15: the west side and a south stretch are re-traced through the solved IMG_2204 camera (pixels on the paving's centre cast onto the surveyed ground): the paving runs at the foot of the curved white wall, about 1.4 m east of the earlier band, which projected onto the wall top, then turns east along the south side behind the hedges for about 10 m (to x -175.8, where the hedges hide it). The north stretch is kept against the north patio fronts: cast through the same camera it lands 1-3 m further north (2-3 m at its east end, where 10 pixels move it a metre), which would put it inside the patios, so it is an open discrepancy, not a correction.

surfaces.name: Calle Isabel's crazy-paving surface beside the north pool lawn
surfaces.note: IMG_2205 (solved station camera) shows the lane down the east side of the lawn paved in the same irregular stone as the lawn-edge path, not terracotta tiles: its west edge, cast through the camera onto the surveyed ground, runs at x -165.9 from z 9.5 to 18 (within 0.3-0.6 m of the mapped lane's west edge), and it reappears beyond the yucca bending south-east (about -163.8, 21.8 to -163.3, 22.6). The east edge is hidden by the yucca, so the surface takes the mapped lane's paved width with its margin (1.32 m), raised 0.21 m to lie just over the lane's own tiles (lanes are drawn 0.27 m over the ground). The lane's line and level stay those of data/street_layout.json; this is its surface.
